pie: h₁ért h₂ŕ̥tḱos ḱóymom h₂ówins-kʷe stéh₂yet. tréset h₁léwdʰis. dʰénwr̥ bʰéronts poh₂imḗn pérwr̥ gʷéh₂t. h₂ŕ̥tḱom kʷéḱt h₁ím-kʷe moréyet. h₁léwdʰis h₁ésmey ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ h₂r̥tḱogʷʰonóm dʰéh₁t. méǵh₂ ḱléwos h₁ésmey h₁ést. h₁ésyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: A bear arrived at the village and stole the sheep. The people trembled. The shepherd went to the mountain, carrying a bow. He caught sight of the bear and killed it. The people set a famous name upon him: Bear-striker. Great fame was his. His fame is imperishable.

pie: ḱwónes h₂ḱh₂owsyéte stóygʰom sékʷedʰwe. nu déh₂nu pró mē dr̥mté. wĺ̥kʷos usmé mē spéḱyoyh₁t.
english: Dogs, hear well, follow the path! Do not run forward to the river. May the wolf not look at you.

pie: h₂ŕ̥tḱos ǵʰiméni str̥h₃méni légʰyet. ḱwṓ h₂ŕ̥tḱosyo stérh₃mn̥ widét léh₂kt-kʷe. dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ím ḱléwt h₁ésyeh₂s-kʷe ph₂tréh₁ h₁ért. bʰéwdʰt h₂ŕ̥tḱos. h₁íh₂ gʷéru Hyéh₁kt h₁íd-kʷe h₂ŕ̥tḱosyo ǵónu térdt. bʰéwgt h₂ŕ̥tḱos pérwr̥. h₂éǵt ph₂tḗr. méreti.
english: In winter the bear was lying in the bed. The dog found the bear's bed and made a noise. The daughter heard it and arrived with her father. The bear awoke. She threw the spear, and it pierced the bear's knee. The bear fled to the mountain. The father said: He will die.

pie: dʰúgh₂ter sddʰí. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m sl̥h₂gʷdʰí. h₁íh₂m̥ yungdʰí wr̥ǵyé-kʷe. téwe susréy pĺ̥h₂seh₂m wr̥ǵdʰí. h₁yód pĺ̥h₂seh₂m wérǵesi ǵʰiméni ne stéwdesi.
english: Daughter, sit down. Take the wool. Join it, and work. Make a garment for your sister. If you make the garment, you will not become cold in winter.

pie: tétḱō wiḱpóteyey sédos démet. h₁íd stoh₂éyet. sédos méǵh₂ h₁ést. wéyḱt wiḱpótis h₁íd h₁ésmi-kʷe sédt.
english: The carpenter built a dwelling for the lord. He set it up. The dwelling was great. The lord went into it and sat down in it.

pie: wiHrós swóm gʷéru Hyéh₁kt h₁íd-kʷe Hrumptó. dʰénh₂t wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím próti. wiHrós bʰéyh₂t. h₁ésyo bʰréh₂tēr ǵʰoysóm h₁épt. ǵʰoysós h₁ésyo ḱḗr térdt. mért wĺ̥kʷos. nu bʰréh₂tēr wiHrṓy gʷéru wérǵt.
english: The man threw his own spear, and it broke. The wolf set off running at him. The man became afraid. His brother seized the javelin. The javelin pierced its heart. The wolf died. Then the brother made a spear for the man.

pie: poh₂imḗn dʰh₂bʰrṓy h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m déh₃t. dʰh₂bʰrós tḱnéy h₁ólom h₁áyt. tétḱō poh₂imnéy kʷékʷlom h₁opéyet. h₁yós dédeh₃ti só h₁áyto.
english: The shepherd gave wool to the smith. The smith gave an awl to the carpenter. The carpenter gave a wheel to the shepherd. Whoever gives, receives.

pie: tń̥tle ǵʰwḗrm̥ lm̥bʰdʰí h₁ím kapyé. twéd kʷid mē bʰugyéh₁t tn̥tlós-kʷe pl̥nh₁ih₁tó.
english: Net, seize the beast, hold it! May nothing flee from you, and may the net become full.

pie: ḱwónes ǵʰwḗrm̥ déh₂nu h₂éǵont. h₁éy wédni snéh₂t. ne sn̥h₂ént. h₁éy h₂én h₁nédʰt. h₁éy h₁íns spéḱyet. déwkt gʰóstis dʰénwr̥ léh₁t-kʷe. h₁éy bʰéwgt. méǵh₂ ḱléwos gʰostéyey ne h₁ést.
english: The dogs drove the beast toward the river. It swam in the water. They did not swim. On the other side it came out. It looked at them. The stranger drew the bow and let go. It got away. Great fame was not his.

pie: h₂éwsos lukdʰí stóygʰom nos déyḱe. ǵʰwḗr-ge n̥smé gʷm̥yóyh₁t. nu h₁ím widéh₁yoyh₁me.
english: Dawn, become bright, show us the path! May the beast indeed come to us. May we see it.

pie: dʰh₂bʰrós gʷréws tḗtḱt. h₁ésmey ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ wl̥kʷogʷʰonóm dʰéh₁t. gʷéru wĺ̥kʷom gʷʰént. h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm bʰúHt. h₁ést méǵh₂ ḱléwos h₁ésmey.
english: The smith made a spear. He set a famous name upon it: Wolf-striker. The spear killed a wolf. Its name became famous. Great fame was his.

pie: h₃mígʰleh₂ h₂éǵroy ḱéyto. dʰugh₂tḗr tn̥tlóm h₂ḱn̥sú h₁entér tn̥néwt. sísdet. h₁nédʰt pórḱos h₃migʰleh₂s h₁ím-kʷe wéyḱt. h₁íh₂ stéh₂t h₁ím-kʷe h₂ḱnéh₁ moréyet. HréwdHt h₁ésyeh₂s-kʷe méh₂tēr h₁ésyeh₂s wókʷm̥ ḱléwt. h₁ért méh₂tēr dʰugh₂tḗr-kʷe méwdt. h₁ím ḱóymom duktā́m.
english: Mist lay on the field. The daughter stretched the net between the stones. She was sitting down. A piglet came out of the mist and entered the net. She stood up and killed it with a stone. She cried out, and her mother heard her voice. The mother arrived, and the daughter became joyful. They pulled it home.

pie: yemHóh₁ pérwr̥ ḱunéh₁ stéygʰetām. h₁éy wĺ̥kʷom kʷéḱt h₁ím-kʷe sékʷomedʰh₂. h₁ést wĺ̥kʷos HéHḱus néḱt-kʷe. sísdetām yemHóh₁ tr̥syétām-kʷe. wr̥h₁tā́m. wĺ̥kʷos HéHḱus h₁ésti pérwr̥-kʷe méǵh₂ h₁ésti. ḱóymom h₁éyomes. h₂usési h₂ew gʷm̥yṓmes.
english: The twins climbed the mountain with the dog. It caught sight of a wolf and followed it. The wolf was swift, and it vanished. The twins were sitting down, and they were thirsty. They spoke. The wolf is swift, and the mountain is great. Let us go home. At dawn we shall come again.

pie: awis akwabʰyams ā wawakat: kard agʰnutai mai widanti manum akwams agantam.
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: ḱunéy h₃ésth₁h₂ h₁opéye. h₁ím wódr̥ wédʰe h₁éy-kʷe péh₃tu. h₁ím mē stunéds. h₁yós h₁ím stunédeti h₁éy tóm ne sékʷetor. h₁éy lewbʰós h₁ésti.
english: Give the bones to the dog. Lead it to the water, and let it drink. Do not hit it. Whoever hits it, it does not follow that one. It is dear.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: akwāsas ā wawakant: krudʰi awai, kard agʰnutai wiwidwant- swas: manus patis warnām awisāms karnauti swabʰyam gʰarmam wastram awibʰyams ka warnā na asti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: wiHrós h₂éḱmonm̥ h₂éǵrom widét. h₁ím skélHt gʷréh₂wonm̥-kʷe h₁ésmōd kʷért. gʷréh₂wonm̥ ḱóymom bʰéret. h₁ésyo pótnih₂ h₁ím kʷéḱt méwdt-kʷe.
english: The husband found a stone in the field. He split it and made a quern out of it. He carried the quern home. His wife saw it and became joyful.

pie: kʷíd súHnew dedórḱth₂e? h₂ŕ̥tḱosyo stóygʰom dedórḱh₂e. h₁ím sékʷeso. déh₂nu kʷsépi mē gʷéh₂s. ḱwónm̥ ḱléwse. h₁éy h₂ḱh₂owsyéti. h₁yód h₁éy HréwdHeti sth₂dʰí. h₂ŕ̥tḱōd mē bʰéwgs. gʷéru tetl̥h₂dʰí.
english: Son, what do you see? I see the bear's path. Follow it! Do not go to the river at night. Listen to the dog. It hears well. If it cries out, stand up. Do not flee from the bear! Hold up the spear.

pie: déywe h₁uséwōm déh₃tor gʰóstis h₁dyéh₁t. nu pótnih₂ h₁dyéh₁t tr̥pih₁mé.
english: God, giver of good things, may the guest eat! May the wife eat, may we be sated.

pie: pérkunos-ge h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. wĺ̥kʷe h₂éǵrōd litdʰí h₂ówins mē gʷm̥yés. ǵʰoysós twé gʷʰn̥yéh₁t gʷéru twé gʷʰn̥yéh₁t.
english: Perkwunos indeed slew the serpent. Wolf, go away from the field, do not come to the sheep! May the javelin strike you, may the spear strike you.

pie: wiHrós pérkum témh₁t. dʰénwr̥ h₁ésmōd péyḱt. snéh₁wr̥ sléh₂gʷt h₁íd-kʷe dʰn̥wéni tn̥néwt. déwkt dʰénwr̥. h₁ésyo bʰréh₂trey dʰénwr̥ h₁áyt.
english: The man cut an oak. He carved a bow out of it. He took the sinew and stretched it on the bow. He drew the bow. He gave the bow to his brother.

pie: pérkum h₂isḱé. h₁ím tm̥h₁dʰí. kʷékʷlom h₁ésmōd piḱdʰí. h₁ím h₁óloh₁ tr̥ddʰí. h₁yód kʷékʷlos Hrunépetor mē HréwdHs. kʷékʷlom h₂ew wr̥ǵdʰí. h₁yós ne Hrumptór só méh₂trey lewbʰós h₁ésti.
english: Seek an oak. Cut it. Carve a wheel out of it. Bore through it with the awl. If the wheel breaks, do not cry out. Make the wheel again. Whichever does not break, that one is dear to the mother.

pie: kʷékʷle dr̥mdʰí kʷékʷle mē Hrumpth₂é. dwóh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ HéHḱuh₁ h₁sih₁tā́m. nu poh₂imnés ḱḗr mudyéh₁t.
english: Wheel, run, wheel, do not break! May the two horses be swift. May the shepherd's heart become joyful.

pie: pérkune nos wékʷos ḱludʰí. HéHḱuns nos ḱwónn̥s dh₃dʰí. méne-ge gʷéru mē h₃slidʰyéh₁t. ǵʰwḗr-ge n̥sméd mē bʰugyéh₁t. mḗms ḱóymom wédʰoyh₁me. nu tébʰye ḱḗr déh₃omes.
english: Perkwunos, hear our word! Give us swift dogs. May my spear indeed not go astray. May the beast indeed not flee from us. May we bring the meat home. Then we shall give you the heart.

pie: h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m sl̥h₂gʷdʰí h₁íh₂m̥-kʷe yungdʰí. tn̥tlóm h₁ésyeh₂s tétḱdʰi. h₁ím h₂ḱn̥sú h₁entér tn̥nudʰí. sddʰí mē-kʷe HréwdHs. h₁yód ǵʰwḗr tn̥tlóm wéyḱeti. sth₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe stunddʰí. h₁yós sédeti ne-kʷe HréwdHeti ǵʰwḗr tósmey gʷm̥yéti.
english: Take the wool and join it. Make a net out of it. Stretch it between stones. Sit down, and do not cry out. If the beast enters the net, stand up and hit it. Whoever sits down and does not cry out, the beast comes to him.

pie: méh₂tēr sédyet. h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m tn̥néwt wr̥ǵyét-kʷe. swéh₂s dʰugh₂tréy pĺ̥h₂seh₂m kʷért. dʰugh₂tḗr pĺ̥h₂seh₂m woséyeto. ǵʰiméni ne stéwdt.
english: The mother was sitting. She stretched the wool, and she worked. She made a garment for her own daughter. The daughter dressed herself in the garment. In winter she did not become cold.

pie: súHnew méne wékʷos ḱludʰí. pérkum tm̥h₁dʰí dʰénwr̥-kʷe h₁ésmōd piḱdʰí. snéh₁wr̥ sl̥h₂gʷdʰí h₁íd-kʷe dʰn̥wéni tn̥nudʰí. dʰénwr̥ mē bʰinéds. h₁íd dukéntu. h₁wésu dʰénwr̥ h₁yósmōy h₁ésti só wĺ̥kʷom ne dedwóye.
english: Son, hear my word! Cut the oak, and carve a bow out of it. Take the sinew and stretch it on the bow. Do not split the bow. Draw it! For whom there is a good bow, he is not afraid of the wolf.
